verdict.rationale: Square's docs reference a Payments API and card/ACH/Afterpay/Cash App payment methods (e.g., square-docs-5–8) that are typically used via embeddable SDKs rather than a hosted redirect page, and the Node SDK sample shows programmatic payment creation (square-gh-1). However, the evidence pack never explicitly names a 'Web Payments SDK' or customizable embeddable UI components, nor contrasts this with a hosted-checkout alternative, so the claim of in-app embeddable, customizable components is only indirectly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an embeddable payment form/SDK, details on UI customization options, and confirmation it avoids redirect-based hosted checkout.
